_schema._about: Portfolio file consumed by /portfolio, /exit-analysis, and the portfolio-reviewer agent. Copy this template to portfolio.json in your working directory and replace the example entries. All dollar amounts are numbers (no $ or commas); rates are decimals (0.065 = 6.5%); dates are YYYY-MM-DD.
_schema.as_of: Date the figures were last updated (YYYY-MM-DD)
_schema.properties[].type: One of: SFR, multifamily, commercial, STR (optional but recommended)
_schema.properties[].acquired: Acquisition date YYYY-MM-DD (optional; enables vintage analysis)
_schema.properties[].basis: Tax basis: purchase price + capital improvements (required)
_schema.properties[].accumulated_depreciation: Depreciation taken to date (optional; needed for /exit-analysis)
_schema.properties[].debt: Current loan balance (required; 0 if free and clear)
_schema.properties[].rate: Current loan interest rate as a decimal (required if debt > 0)
_schema.properties[].maturity: Loan maturity date YYYY-MM-DD (required if debt > 0)
_schema.properties[].value_source: Where the value came from: appraisal | AVM | user estimate (optional)
_schema.properties[].notes: Free text: tenant situation, planned capex, sale plans, etc. (optional)
